topic: A road trip with my grandmother
title: Long Way
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Grandma.
She packed a thermos and an old paper map that she had kept in the glove compartment of her nineteen sixty-two Chevrolet since before I was born,
drove.
We stopped at a diner where the waitress, who had apparently known my grandmother for many years, gave us two slices of cherry pie for free.

[Chorus]
Long way.
Grandma takes the long way home through every small town in the state and tells me a story about each one of them until the sun goes down,
home.
Yes.

[Verse 2]
Then she showed me the dance hall.
It closed in nineteen eighty-four after the owner moved to Florida with his second wife and the building became a hardware store and then nothing at all.
Pine.

[Chorus]
Long way.
Home.
